parsed.name: 威尔创 360 网络分析仪
parsed.description: 用于射频/微波测试的网络分析仪，可进行频率扫描并读取横轴、纵轴及复数迹线数据，适合器件频率响应表征与分析。
parsed.description_en: An RF/microwave network analyzer used for frequency sweeps and acquisition of x-axis, y-axis, and complex trace data for device response characterization and analysis.

actions.description: 获取当前扫描的横轴数据，通常为频率点。
actions.description_en: Get the current sweep x-axis data, typically frequency points.

actions.description: 获取当前迹线的纵轴测量数据。
actions.description_en: Get the y-axis measurement data of the current trace.

actions.description: 获取指定或当前迹线的数据，可包含与频率轴对应的复数响应。
actions.description_en: Get the specified or current trace data, including complex response aligned with the frequency axis.

actions.description: 获取全部可用迹线的数据。
actions.description_en: Get data for all available traces.

actions.description: 选择要操作或读取的迹线。
actions.description_en: Select the trace to operate on or read.

actions.description: 获取或设置频率扫描相关配置。
actions.description_en: Get or set the frequency sweep configuration.
Get the number of sweep points.

actions.description: 执行自动量程或自动范围调整。
actions.description_en: Perform auto-ranging or automatic range adjustment.
